title: KCP governance_disable request (amendment A5 wire name; greenfield-saga §4)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2). Freezes the owner binding (status active→frozen, owner arm retained for audit) and invalidates derived channels and permits. Exists only from active: after the CAS there is no rollback. Re-enablement after a governed disable is a fresh saga row under a new binding epoch, not a transition of this machine. Assurance is ALWAYS step-up (frozen authority row); in the personal profile the required exact-digest confirmation is the honest stand-in, labeled developer assurance. Registry (governed_work_binding_v1): surface operator / human realm-owner principal only — never a service identity, session, assistant, or connector. Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible.

expected_owner_revision.description: Exact-CAS field: the active KoveeGovernanceOwnerBinding revision.

confirmed_subject_digest.description: REQUIRED: governance_disable is always step-up, so the exact subject digest of the active enablement must be confirmed.

args.description: The exact active binding, its expected owner revision, and the confirmed subject digest.

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256/HMAC value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

class.description: Family digest class (byom family-vectors PROFILE §6, D-R0-1). Governed-work host records use scope_erasure_safe: one protected per-realm governance key, so destroying it erases verifiability of the whole governance scope, never one row.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed family DigestRef (PROFILE §6.1), never an unlabelled hash. The class/algorithm pairing and the key_ref-presence rule for the keyed classes are enforced in code (they are a cross-member constraint the closed object cannot express here).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

selector.description: Kovee governed-scope selector, at most 256 visible-ASCII bytes. byom pins only this bounded opaque wire shape (C2 host schemas); the grammar (realm | project:<id|*>[/space:<id|*>]) and the overlap predicate of byom §16.6 item 1 are Kovee-owned and live in kovee_byom::scope.

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
